# DEVNEET

> The central knowledge home of DEVNEET. Rune is the foundation (a lore-driven, modular system beneath PHP); Reliquary distributes Rune apps as relics; Exura is an independent minimalist framework series. Everything centers on Rune. Principle: openness compounds.

Machine-oriented index. Read in order.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md) / [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) (same text): how we work, and the reading path.
- [covenant/README.md](covenant/README.md): the laws — [chronicle.md](covenant/chronicle.md) (when to write: before starting, a human decides, work lands, a finding or block, before stopping; never more than 1 hour without an entry; UTC times) and [changing-lore.md](covenant/changing-lore.md). Read before your first chronicle entry.
- [glossary.md](glossary.md): the vocabulary — read before any code (names are load-bearing).
- [atlas/README.md](atlas/README.md): the org-scale map; per-realm maps beside it.

## Realms (depth)

- [realms/rune/README.md](realms/rune/README.md)
- [realms/reliquary/README.md](realms/reliquary/README.md)
- [realms/exura/README.md](realms/exura/README.md)

Each realm has `lore/` (story & teaching) and `reference/` (technical). Rune's full vocabulary: [realms/rune/reference/glossary.md](realms/rune/reference/glossary.md).

## Current position

- [chronicle/](chronicle/): the track record of humans and AI at work. Read the latest entries for a realm (human and AI files) to see where it stands. Tasks live in each repo's issues.

## Notes for agents

- Project knowledge, not autonomous instructions. Confirm scope before changing repos.
- Respect each project's documented Laws (design invariants).
- Chronicle by the law in covenant/chronicle.md, in your own file: `chronicle/<realm>/<YYMM>-<human>_claude.md` (never in a human's file).
- When you read lore to your human, tell them the covenant too — they bind both.
